title: 3.2.21 Lab: Scope Prediction Exercise
description: Write a global and a local variable, then try to read the local one outside its function and watch the ReferenceError. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Declare a global variable
steps.instructions: Outside any function, declare a variable called score with let and set it to a number. It is global, so every function can read it.

steps.title: Read the global from inside a function
steps.instructions: Define a function called showScore that uses console.log to print score. Because score is global, the function can read it.

steps.title: Declare a local variable inside another function
steps.instructions: Define a second function called describeScore. Inside it, declare a variable called label with let, then log score and label together. The label only exists while this function runs.

steps.title: Prove the local is invisible outside
steps.instructions: Call both functions so the working cases run. Then, after the calls, write a console.log of a local-only variable so the console shows a ReferenceError, proving a local variable cannot be reached from outside its function. Leave a comment saying what you expect before you run it.
